title: Badassery site config
description: Site-wide settings used by the build (config/site.yaml).

url.description: Public address of the site, without a trailing slash, e.g. "https://badassery.club". Used for sitemap.xml and robots.txt.

email.description: Contact email shown in the footer.

booking_url.description: Zenchef reservation link used by the RESERVAR buttons.

google_maps_url.description: Google Maps link for the venue address.

instagram_url.description: Instagram profile link (header menu, footer and JSON-LD sameAs).

hero.description: Full-screen background video at the top of index2.html.

video_desktop.description: 16:9 MP4 (H.264) for landscape screens, relative to src/, e.g. "assets/videos/16x9.mp4".

video_mobile.description: 9:16 MP4 (H.264) for portrait screens, relative to src/, e.g. "assets/videos/9x16.mp4".

fallback_image.description: Photo shown when the video can't play.

width.description: Width of the -1200 JPG in px.

height.description: Height of the -1200 JPG in px.

hours.description: Opening hours; each entry is one paragraph in the footer.
